snippet.title: [Longplay] SMS - Golvellius The Valley of Doom
snippet.description:
This playthrough completes the game while collecting 100% of items and without dying. This video can be used as a walkthrough as it shows the full game. 

Game: Golvellius the Valley of Doom - Sega Master System 
Footage is upscaled to High Definition HD

Subscribe for more longplays like this

Note that many playthroughs on this channel use savestates, meaning that individual sections are retried until they are error-free for the final video.
